# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_009_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 3, Chapter 1

**1** The third vision which I saw, brothers and sisters, was as follows. **2** After I had fasted often and asked the Lord to show me the revelation which he promised me through the aged woman, that same night the aged woman appeared to me and said, "Since you are so persistent and eager to know all things, come to the field where you farm, and about the fifth hour I will appear to you and show you what it is necessary for you to see." **3** I asked her, "Lady, what part of the field?" She said, "Wherever you wish. Only choose a quiet place." And before I could speak and designate the place, she said, "I will come to where you are." **4** I went, brothers and sisters, to the field and counted the hours, and came to the place. And I saw an ivory couch and upon it a linen pillow and above that a fine linen covering. **5** When I saw these things lying there with no one in the place, I was struck with awe and a trembling seized me and my hair stood on end. And when I recovered myself, I saw the aged woman coming — with a book in her hand — and she sat down alone and greeted me: "Greetings, man of God." I was filled with grief, and I wept. **6** She said to me, "Why are you weeping?" I said, "Because, lady, I do not know if I can endure to the end." She said to me, "Be confident, for you have been placed by the Lord to endure the temptations of this world — to endure for yourself and for your household. Be therefore courageous." **7** I said to her, "Lady, show me the vision." She said, "Do you wish to see it right now?" I said, "Lady, I have great longing to see." She reached out to me and touched me, and I felt as if I had just bathed. **8** She said, "Let us go." And I saw the things of which I spoke before — the great tower being built with brilliant squared stones.

---

*EMET note: Vision 3 begins with a repeat of the preparatory rituals — the field, the couch, the aged woman — establishing a structural parallelism with the previous Visions.*
